title: Core's board check finds the board in the agent's own clone of its repository
goal: Vision: V-8. CEO Mandate 83, rule 7: every agent works in both repositories. Core's board check refused in a core checkout unless the board's address was set by hand, so the sync step of Mandates 82 and 83 failed there. When nothing else names a board, use the clone of the board's private repository under the agent's root; never a clone whose origin is this public repository.

reuse.searched: crates/susi-core/src/native_board.rs (resolve_board_target: address by environment or setting, a board remote, a non-public origin; is_public_susi_remote_url) and the same rule already in the workflow tool of intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps (board::home: the board's clone under the agent root). The existing resolver gains that one last place to look; nothing new is built.

limitations: Reads and checks the board through the agent's clone. Posting from a host whose storage credentials refuse board refs still goes through the workflow tool, which posts through the private repository's main.
Main is unqualified development, not a release.
